name: silver box (HANDMADE), shared geometry for present (U2) and shadow play (U3)
units: box width w (all lengths are fractions of w)
hinge: back top edge (y = depth, z = body_h); lid opens toward the back, 0 deg closed, 105 deg = 100% open

slot.note: cx in units of w across the inner floor; cy as fraction of inner depth measured from the front wall; slot long axis parallel to the front

ring_hollow.note: pressed elliptical hollow around the slot (fractions of inner width/depth)

front_pattern: guilloche: engine-turned rose r*f + 0.18 sin(14a + 30r) blended with wave band, f = 38 cycles per w on the front face; bevelled border 0.02w
key_note: V0's real key is a flash high camera-RIGHT and front (his head shadow falls left on the wall); x right, y away from camera, z up
match_test: slot centre on screen in present insert vs shadow-play box, normalised by box width, differs < 0.05
